newsitem.headline: Sun Healthcare Group Inc Q3 loss vs profit.

text.p: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
Fully diluted net earnings per share
Fully diluted net earnings per share

(a) The results for the nine months ended September 30, 1995 represent pro forma amounts adjusted for statutory income taxes Golden Care would have paid prior to its changing from a S to a C corporation for income tax purposes in May 1995.

(b) Sun recorded an extraordinary loss of $3.4 million on an early extinguishment of debt in January 1995. Sun incurred a nonrecurring charge of $3.3 million paid to induce the conversion of $39.4 million of 6 1/2 pct Convertible Subordinated Debentures which was expensed in the first quarter of 1995. Merger costs of $5.8 million related to the Golden Care and CareerStaff mergers and a nonrecurring tax charge of $1.5 million related to the conversion of Golden Care from a S to a C Corp were recorded in the Q2 1995.

(c) Sun incurred a nonrecurring charge of $24 million relating to Sun's agreement in principle to settle certain securities class action lawsuits, filed in 1995, against the company and certain current and former Sun directors.
